## Singapore Conference Stay Plan

A 2-day business trip works best if you stay in the Marina Bay / Downtown Core / Bugis edge area, where transit to Marina Bay Sands is usually well under 20 minutes and you can still find practical work-friendly hotels under your budget.

## Best Hotel Shortlist Near Marina Bay Sands

| Hotel | Area | Typical Transit to MBS | Why it fits | Nightly Budget Fit |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Hotel G Singapore | Bugis / Bencoolen | 15–20 min | Compact business-friendly rooms, usually quieter upper floors, good desk setup in higher room categories | Often under SGD 260 |
| ibis Singapore on Bencoolen | Bencoolen | 15–20 min | Reliable value stay, central MRT access, practical for solo business travel | Often under SGD 260 |
| Mercure Singapore Bugis | Bugis | 15–18 min | Strong location for MRT access, better chance of a proper workspace in upgraded room types | Sometimes near budget cap |
| V Hotel Bencoolen | Bencoolen | 15–20 min | Convenient for early mornings and quick rides to Marina Bay | Often under SGD 260 |
| lyf Funan Singapore | City Hall / Funan | 10–15 min | Very central, good transit access, some room types are better suited for short work sessions | Can fit if booked early |

## Recommended Booking Strategy for Flights, Hotel, and Transfer

| Step | What to book | Best timing | Why this order |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 1 | Hotel | First | Your hotel is the tightest constraint: budget, transit time, quiet workspace, and early check-in are all limited by availability |
| 2 | Flights | Second | Once hotel location is fixed, choose flight times that align with check-in and conference arrival |
| 3 | Airport transfer | Last | Transfer choice depends on your exact arrival time, luggage, and whether you need the fastest hotel arrival or cheapest option |

### How to book each part
- **Hotel first**
  - Filter for: Marina Bay / Bugis / City Hall / Bencoolen.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/ae/1_singapore_national_day_parade_2011_fireworks.jpg Alt=Filter for: Marina Bay / Bugis / City Hall / Bencoolen, Singapore
  - Ask for: **quiet room**, **desk or work table**, **higher floor**, and **early check-in request**.
  - If early check-in is not guaranteed, book the night before only if your arrival is very early.
- **Flights second**
  - Aim to land in Singapore the day before the conference starts, if possible.
  - Choose arrival times that give you a buffer for immigration, transfer, and a short rest.
- **Transfer last**
  - If arriving during peak hours, prebook a car transfer for convenience.
  - If arriving outside rush hour, MRT or taxi is usually fine and often faster than waiting for shared transport.

## 2-Day Conference Trip Flow

### Day 1: Arrival and Settle In
- Morning: Fly into Singapore and head straight to the hotel.
- Afternoon: Request early check-in or store luggage, then test Wi‑Fi and set up your workspace.
- Evening: Keep dinner simple near the hotel and sleep early for the conference.

### Day 2: Conference Day
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/24/Singapore_Conference_Hall%2C_October_2025.jpg Alt=Day 2: Conference Day, Singapore
- Morning: Leave for Marina Bay Sands with a 20–30 minute buffer.
- Afternoon: Return to the hotel if you need a quiet break or quick work session.
- Evening: Choose a nearby dinner spot and prepare for the next day’s departure.
